## Fictional retention
At Velora Audio Archive, listening cards are kept for 45 days. If a correction review is open, retain the affected cards until the review is closed, even after the 45-day period.

## Fictional copy requests
At Velora Audio Archive, a public copy request received before 14:00 is sent the same operating day. At or after 14:00, send it on the next operating day. If the rights review is unresolved, do not send the copy until that review closes.
